name: Cocamide MEA
description: Cocamide MEA (CAS 68140-00-1 ), derived from coconut oil fatty acids and monoethanolamine, is a fatty acid alkanolamide used across personal care and industrial cleaning formulations. Known commercially as a foam booster and viscosity builder, it conditions lather texture and stabilizes surfactant systems in rinse-off and leave-on products alike. In shampoos and liquid soaps, this ingredient thickens the base formula and enhances foam density without requiring high loading levels for the manufacturer. Bar soap and solid shampoo manufacturers incorporate it to improve hardness and skin feel in pressed formats, ensuring a premium experience for the end user. Industrial and household cleaners rely on it to sustain foam stability under hard water conditions and in the presence of soils during heavy-duty cleaning tasks. Textile and paper processing operations use it as an emulsifier and dispersant to support uniform wetting and fiber treatment throughout the production cycle. The material is supplied as a solid flake or waxy solid at ambient temperature, with liquid forms available at elevated temperatures or in diluted blends. Standard commercial grades are offered for cosmetic and industrial applications, with packaging typically ranging from 25 kg bags through to bulk quantities.
